notes: s017's note cites rule 106, but λέγω carries no preverb: giving out is an English phrasal rendering whose particle belongs to the verb's own unit under rules 7 and 15. The unit membership and head are unaffected; the citation is what should be revised.

τινα μέγαν → some great one puts the generic one on the adjective under rule 17; assigning the discontinuous some … one to τινα, as 8:31 does for a bare τις, is the competing reading, and the two constructions differ in that only 8:31 has no adjective to complete.
